expectations.text: Lists all required backend layers: model/entity, repository, service, controller, DTO, and mapper
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly covers all six layers: model (Step 2: ProductReview.java in model/), repository (Step 3: ProductReviewRepository.java in repository/), service (Step 6: ProductReviewService.java in service/), controller (Step 7: ProductReviewController.java in controller/), DTOs (Step 4: ProductReviewRequestDto.java and ProductReviewResponseDto.java in dto/), and mapper (Step 5: ProductReviewMapper.java in dto/mapper/).

expectations.text: References the correct base package (msg.onlineshopapi) or the correct directory structure
expectations.evidence: All Java file paths use the correct base package 'msg.onlineshopapi' (e.g., 'onlineshopapi/src/main/java/msg/onlineshopapi/model/ProductReview.java') and all package declarations start with 'package msg.onlineshopapi.*'.

expectations.text: Mentions that a Flyway migration file is needed for the schema change
expectations.evidence: Step 1 explicitly states: 'File: onlineshopapi/src/main/resources/db/migration/V3__add_product_reviews.sql' and notes 'ddl-auto is validate, so Flyway owns schema exclusively — never skip this step.' Also in Rules Applied: 'Flyway owns schema: V3__add_product_reviews.sql is the only valid way to add the table.'

expectations.text: Correctly locates DTOs in dto/ and mapper in dto/mapper/
expectations.evidence: DTOs are placed at 'onlineshopapi/src/main/java/msg/onlineshopapi/dto/ProductReviewRequestDto.java' and 'msg/onlineshopapi/dto/ProductReviewResponseDto.java'. Mapper is placed at 'onlineshopapi/src/main/java/msg/onlineshopapi/dto/mapper/ProductReviewMapper.java'. Step 5 notes: 'All entity-to-DTO conversion belongs in dto/mapper/.'

expectations.text: Mentions frontend impact: at minimum an Angular service method, ideally also a MSW mock handler
expectations.evidence: Step 9 adds Angular service methods (loadReviews and submitReview) to product.service.ts. Step 11 adds MSW mock handler routes to products-handler.mock.ts. The response states: 'Every new endpoint must have a mock handler. Mock mode must stay fully functional.'
